title: 第一百三十一章 神仆第一百三十章 金丝蛛
content_zh:
第一百三十一章神仆
面对极品皇器金丝蛛的凌厉攻势，索科神皇不敢有丝毫轻视。目睹神族修士遭受偷袭而陨落，他却没有半点出手相助的意思。于他而言，这些神族修士本身就是保护自身安全的一道屏障，能为自己赴死，于他们而言亦是无上殊荣。
秦枫以破虚境的肉身之力，出其不意，斩杀六名潜伏的神族修士后，手持长戟立于虚空，紧盯着缠斗中的索科神皇，周身气机蓄而不发，随时准备再度出手。
目睹秦枫的强势出手，让索科神皇大为震惊。这些神族修士都是他悉心培养的神仆，个个修为稳固，皆是货真价实的元婴期强者，每个人的战力都不容小觑。可眼前这位青衣修士仅凭一己之力，便在瞬息之间连斩六位神仆。这般凌厉的杀伐与强悍的实力，就算是他亲自出手，也未必能做到这般干脆利落。
索科神皇心中惊疑，当即放出一缕神识探查秦枫修为。察觉对方不过结丹后期，荒诞之感油然而生，暗自沉思：“这怎么可能？区区结丹修为，竟能如此轻松斩杀元婴修士，此人定是持有隐匿感知的皇器，这就难怪他先前以神识反复探查，却始终没有发现对方的踪迹。”
稍作思索，索科神皇心中已有定论。对方此番得手，全凭强横的修为，抓住偷袭的绝佳时机，再加上极限的速度与王器双月戟的加持，方才爆发出如此惊人的战力。
他一边催动乌拉神山，抵挡金丝蛛连绵不绝的攻势，一边抬眼望向凌空而立的秦枫，带着上位者的威严，开口道：“看来，你便是秦枫。”
秦枫横持长戟，神色从容，朗声回道：“神皇大人，如今出手对付一个晚辈，还用得着带这么多帮手，此事若是传出去，就不怕沦为修真界的笑柄。”
索科神皇闻言纵声长笑，并没有将秦枫的讥讽当回事，而是细细打量着秦枫，眼中带着几分审视，徐徐说道：“秦公子的敛气之术倒是精妙绝伦，竟能彻底隐匿气息，避开我的神识探查。你若是一直隐于暗处不现身，还确实有点麻烦。”
说罢，他微微侧首，看向立于金丝蛛背上的雪林君，语气带着几分刻意的赞许：“雪家主，今日此事，我先为你记上一功。”
秦枫闻言当即忍不住噗嗤一笑，眼底满是讥讽：“想不到执掌一方神域的堂堂神皇，竟也玩挑拨离间这般上不得台面的伎俩。”
索科神皇闻言非但不恼，反而发出一阵爽朗的笑声，朝着虚空喝道：“都现身吧。”
话音落下的刹那，四方虚空泛起层层涟漪，六十六道神族修士的身影自虚空之中显现。这群神族修士个个气息雄浑，周身神力涌动，无一例外皆是元婴期的修为。
数十道雄浑强横的气息彼此相融，化作一股铺天盖地的磅礴气势，将天地万物死死压制。
索科神皇再次看向秦枫，嘴角勾起一抹玩味的笑意：“秦公子，你看这样如何？”
“神皇行事倒是干脆利落。”秦枫非但没有惧色，反倒燃起了浓烈的战意，“我正愁找不到合适的对手，没想到神皇大人倒是有心了，早早便为我备好了对手。”
第一百三十一章神仆
“是吗？”索科神皇淡淡一笑，“那便要看秦公子，有没有这份福气消受了。”
这时，雪林君眉头微蹙，开口说道：“索科神皇，没想到，你竟将七十二神仆尽数带在身边。”
“此事也是被逼无奈啊。”索科神皇轻笑一声，“说到底都要归咎于秦笑天，好端端的破境至玉清境干吗？他的实力暴涨，使得我们这些老朋友都缺少安全感，不得不加强防备，步步小心。”

在交谈之际，六十六位神仆悄然调整位置，无声无息间布成一座杀伐大阵，将秦枫困于阵中。
秦枫仔细打量眼前的大阵，以他的阵法修为，自然能看出此阵威力不容小觑。可神识扫过阵中几处节点，他立刻察觉到六处明显的破绽。稍加思索便已明白，这些破绽应该是那六名神仆殒命后，阵位空缺、灵力衔接断裂所致。
如今他的雷遁术已修炼至第三层大圆满，借雷霆之力，可在防御、困杀各种阵法中来去自如。面对这座已有破绽的大阵，更是无所畏惧。
可就在大阵成型的一瞬，六十六位神仆的神力相互交融，浑然一体。一股骇人的灵压冲天而起，此等力量绝非修为的简单叠加，而是借助阵法之力，将修为成倍放大。狂暴的灵压如同万丈山岳，朝着阵中的秦枫碾压而来。
秦枫立刻运转灵力，试图抵挡这股狂暴的灵压。可这股被阵法成倍放大后的灵压，实在太过强横，竟硬生生阻滞了他体内灵力的流转，连行动都变得迟缓起来。秦枫心底一沉，暗道：莫非这次，当真有些过于托大了？
危急关头，秦枫不敢再有所保留，当即催动丹田中的金、木、水、火、土五颗天道蕴灵大圆满的金丹。
随着五行金丹与雷丹的逐渐融合，如今丹田内已演化出一方微型小世界的雏形，五行本源相生相济，自成生生不息的天道循环。
五颗金丹的同时运转，浑厚的五行之力顷刻之间涌遍全身，化作一层无形护罩。大阵倾泻而下的恐怖灵压撞击在护罩之上，瞬间被五行之力消解、隔绝。任凭外界灵压如何狂暴冲击，却再也无法撼动秦枫分毫。
摆脱了灵压的束缚，秦枫手腕一拧长戟，戟锋直刺前方一名神仆。就在戟锋距对方三尺距离时，神仆身前一面神力凝聚而成的灵盾，挡下了长戟的攻击。
预想中一戟破防的场面并未发生，戟盾相撞的瞬间，灵盾反而爆发出一股强横的反震之力，顺着戟身反噬而来。
秦枫连人带戟被震得连连倒退数十丈，方才站稳，浑身气血翻涌，双臂刺痛、虎口震颤，长戟险些脱手。
不等他稳定气血，六十六名神仆同时动了。众人各持一柄漆黑长刀，同时挥斩而出。六十六道幽黑刀芒从不同角度袭来，织成一张绝杀刀网，断绝了秦枫所有退路。
危急时刻，秦枫引动雷丹之力，身形化作一道紫黑电芒，在密不透风的刀芒之中穿梭，倾刻间便遁出了大阵。
刚遁出大阵，秦枫随即反手出戟，戟锋直取一名神仆后心。可依旧被灵盾拦下，再度遭到巨力反噬。

Chapter 131 Servant of God
Faced with the fierce offensive of the top-notch imperial weapon Golden Silk Spider, God Emperor Soko did not dare to despise it in the slightest. Seeing the divine monks fall under a sneak attack, he had no intention of helping. For him, these divine monks themselves are a barrier to protect their own safety, and it is also a supreme honor for them to die for themselves.
Qin Feng used the physical strength of the Void-Breaking Realm to catch six lurking divine monks by surprise. He then stood in the void with a halberd in his hand, staring closely at the fighting God Emperor Suoko. The energy in his body was not being released, and he was ready to strike again at any time.
Witnessing Qin Feng's strong attack shocked God Emperor Soko. These divine monks are all his servants who have been carefully cultivated by him. All of them have stable cultivation and are genuine Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses. Their combat prowess cannot be underestimated. But the monk in green clothes in front of him killed six servants of the gods in an instant with just his own strength. With such fierce killing and powerful strength, even if he takes action personally, he may not be able to do it so neatly.
Emperor Suoko was shocked and doubtful, and immediately released a ray of divine consciousness to explore Qin Feng's cultivation. Realizing that the other party was only in the late stage of Dan Formation, a sense of absurdity arose spontaneously, and he thought to himself: "How is this possible? With only a mere Dan Formation cultivation, he can kill a Nascent Soul monk so easily. This person must possess the imperial weapon of hidden perception. It is no wonder that he has repeatedly used his spiritual consciousness to detect the opponent before, but has never found any trace of the other party."
After thinking for a moment, God Emperor Soko had already made up his mind. The opponent's success this time was all due to his tyrannical cultivation, seizing the perfect opportunity for a sneak attack, coupled with extreme speed and the blessing of the king's double moon halberd, to unleash such astonishing combat power.
While he was urging the Holy Mountain of Ula to resist the continuous offensive of the Golden Silk Spider, he raised his eyes to look at Qin Feng standing in the sky. With the majesty of a superior, he said: "It seems that you are Qin Feng."
Qin Feng held his halberd horizontally, with a calm look on his face, and replied loudly: "Lord God Emperor, you don't need to bring so many helpers to deal with a junior now. If this matter spreads, you won't be afraid of becoming a laughing stock in the cultivation world."
God Emperor Suoko laughed loudly when he heard this, and did not take Qin Feng's sarcasm seriously. Instead, he looked at Qin Feng carefully, with a bit of scrutiny in his eyes, and said slowly: "Master Qin's Qi gathering technique is quite exquisite. He can completely conceal his Qi and avoid my spiritual detection. If you keep hiding in the dark and not showing up, it will really be a bit troublesome."
After saying that, he tilted his head slightly and looked at Mr. Xue Lin, who was standing on the back of the golden silk spider, with a hint of deliberate approval in his tone: "Master Xue, for today's matter, I will first record your merit for you."
Qin Feng couldn't help but chuckle when he heard this, his eyes full of sarcasm: "I didn't expect that the majestic divine emperor who is in charge of a divine domain would actually play such a shameless trick as sowing discord."
God Emperor Soko was not annoyed when he heard this. Instead, he let out a burst of hearty laughter and shouted towards the void: "Everyone, please show up."
The moment the words fell, ripples appeared in the void in all directions, and the figures of sixty-six divine monks appeared from the void. This group of divine monks all have powerful auras and surging divine power all over their bodies. Without exception, they are all at the Nascent Soul stage.
Dozens of powerful and powerful auras merged with each other, turning into an overwhelming majestic momentum that suppressed everything in the world.
God Emperor Suoko looked at Qin Feng again, with a playful smile on his lips: "Master Qin, what do you think of this?"
"The God-Emperor acts neatly and neatly." Qin Feng not only showed no fear, but also had a strong fighting spirit. "I was worried about not being able to find a suitable opponent, but I didn't expect that the God-Emperor was interested and had prepared an opponent for me long ago."
Chapter 131 Servant of God
"Really?" God Emperor Suoko smiled faintly, "Then it depends on Mr. Qin whether he can accept this blessing."
At this time, Lord Xue Lin frowned slightly and said, "God Emperor Suoko, I didn't expect that you would bring all seventy-two divine servants with you.around. "
“This matter is also forced into helplessness. "God Emperor Suoko chuckled, "In the end, it's all Qin Xiaotian's fault. Why did he break through to Yuqing Realm without any trouble? His strength has skyrocketed, making old friends like us feel insecure and have to strengthen our defenses and be careful every step of the way. "
While talking, the sixty-six divine servants quietly adjusted their positions and silently formed a killing formation, trapping Qin Feng in the formation.
Qin Feng carefully looked at the large formation in front of him. Based on his formation skills, he could naturally see that the power of this formation should not be underestimated. But his consciousness scanned several nodes in the formation, and he immediately noticed six obvious flaws. After a little thought, it became clear that these flaws should be caused by the vacancies in the formation and the break in spiritual connection after the death of the six servants of God.
Now his Thunder Escape Technique has been cultivated to the third level of perfection. With the power of thunder, he can move freely in various defense and trap formations. Facing this already flawless formation, he was even more fearless.
But at the moment when the formation was formed, the divine powers of the sixty-six divine servants blended with each other and became one. A terrifying amount of spiritual pressure soared into the sky. This power was by no means a simple superposition of cultivation levels, but rather, with the help of the power of the formation, the cultivation levels were multiplied. The violent spiritual pressure was like a ten thousand-foot mountain, crushing towards Qin Feng in the formation.
Qin Feng immediately used his spiritual power to try to resist this violent spiritual pressure. But this spiritual pressure, which was multiplied by the formation, was so powerful that it actually blocked the flow of spiritual power in his body, and even his movements became sluggish. Qin Feng's heart sank, and he thought to himself: Could it be that this time, it was really too much?
At the critical moment, Qin Feng did not dare to hold back any longer, and immediately activated the five golden elixirs of gold, wood, water, fire, and earth in his dantian.
With the gradual integration of the five elements golden elixir and the thunder elixir, the prototype of a miniature world has now evolved in the Dantian. The origins of the five elements complement each other and create an endless cycle of heaven.
The five golden elixirs were running at the same time, and the powerful power of the five elements instantly surged throughout the body, turning into an invisible shield. The terrifying spiritual pressure pouring down from the formation hit the shield and was instantly dissolved and isolated by the power of the five elements. No matter how violently the external spiritual pressure impacted, it could no longer shake Qin Feng in the slightest.
Freed from the shackles of spiritual pressure, Qin Feng twisted his halberd with his wrist, and the blade of the halberd stabbed a divine servant in front of him. Just when the halberd was three feet away from the opponent, a spiritual shield formed by condensed divine power in front of the servant of God blocked the halberd's attack.
The expected scene of the halberd breaking through the defense did not happen. The moment the halberd and the shield collided, the spiritual shield instead burst out with a powerful counterattack force that came back along the halberd body.
Qin Feng and his halberd were shaken back several dozen feet. Only then did he stand firm. Qi and blood surged all over his body. His arms tingled, his mouth trembled, and he almost lost his grip on the halberd.
Before he could stabilize his energy and blood, sixty-six divine servants moved at the same time. Everyone held a long black sword and slashed it out at the same time. Sixty-six rays of dark sword light struck from different angles, weaving into a deadly knife net, cutting off all Qin Feng's escape routes.
At the critical moment, Qin Feng activated the power of Thunder Pill, and his body turned into a purple-black electric light, shuttled among the airtight sword light, and escaped from the formation in an instant.
As soon as he escaped from the formation, Qin Feng shot out his halberd with his backhand, and the blade of the halberd hit the back of a divine servant. But he was still blocked by the spiritual shield and was counterattacked by a huge force again.
